title: 5 Questions with NBA insider Brian Windhorst
summary: Find out Windhorst’s biggest scoop and hottest NBA take in this quick-fire interview with Rappler!

blocks.text: Find out Windhorst’s biggest scoop and hottest NBA take in this quick-fire interview with Rappler!

MANILA, Philippines – Brian Windhorst has covered the NBA as a sports journalist for more than two decades. He reported for Akron Beacon Journal and Cleveland Plain Dealer from 2003 to 2010 before joining his current network, ESPN.
It seems the world already knows all there is to know about Windhorst, or “Windy” to most.
But what’s the biggest story he’s broken, and what’s his hottest take on the NBA? Find out in this quick interview with Rappler during his recent visit to Manila. – Rappler.com
